sections.title: Silver Keys
sections.note: 1,000 Rupees in each stage for its Great Fairy's Silver Key; all three raise Vaati's Palace.

items.name: Chambers of Insight
items.area: Domed yellow building on an island in south-east Hyrule
items.howTo: The optional tutorial, open from the start. Stand on the warp zones together: two levels of basics, a level for each of the Bow, Pegasus Boots, Boomerang, Roc's Cape and Magnetic Glove, and a two-level final test that ends with an Ice Wizzrobe. Leave by the southernmost warp zones.
items.notes: Not needed to finish the game, and not part of speedrun.com's 100%. The only stage whose warp zones lead back to earlier levels.

items.name: Sea of Trees: Silver Key
items.area: Two bird-like statues in central Hyrule
items.howTo: Clear two floors and defeat Big Manhandla on the third: stun it, then cut or bomb its flower heads. With at least 1,000 Rupees between you, the Great Fairy of Forest gives each Link a Silver Key.
items.notes: Open from the start; the three stages can be done in any order. Items found here: Bomb, Boomerang, Bow, Gnat Hat, Roc's Cape, Shield. Fewer than 1,000 Rupees gets no key; play the stage again. Every Link gets a key, so each player's own file tracks it.

items.name: Talus Cave: Silver Key
items.area: Stone doorway at the foot of a mountain in western Hyrule
items.howTo: Clear two icy floors and defeat Dera Zol on the third. With at least 1,000 Rupees between you, the Great Fairy of Ice gives each Link a Silver Key.
items.notes: Adds the Magnetic Glove and Pegasus Boots to the Sea of Trees items.

items.name: Death Mountain: Silver Key
items.howTo: Clear two floors of lava and flames and defeat Gouen on the third. With at least 1,000 Rupees between you, the Great Fairy of Flame gives each Link a Silver Key.
items.notes: Adds the Chain Chomp to the Talus Cave items.

items.name: Vaati's Palace: silver door
items.area: Floating palace above Hyrule (the Palace of Winds)
items.howTo: With all three Silver Keys the palace appears in the sky. Open the silver door, clear two wind-themed levels in the sky and defeat Vaati on the third: first his armored statue form, then his true form.
items.reward: The ending; the Great Fairies now give Golden Keys
items.notes: Anniversary Edition: also opens the Realm of Memories (Anniversary Edition tracker).

sections.title: Golden Keys
sections.note: After the silver door: 3,000 Rupees in a stage for its Golden Key.

items.name: Sea of Trees: Golden Key
items.howTo: Play the Sea of Trees again and finish with at least 3,000 Rupees between you. Big Manhandla sprouts more flowers at this difficulty.
items.notes: 1,000 to 2,999 Rupees earns nothing new once you hold the Silver Key.

items.name: Talus Cave: Golden Key
items.howTo: Play Talus Cave again and finish with at least 3,000 Rupees between you. Dera Zol starts making illusions at higher difficulties.

items.name: Death Mountain: Golden Key
items.howTo: Play Death Mountain again and finish with at least 3,000 Rupees between you.

items.name: Vaati's Palace: golden door
items.howTo: Open the golden door with the three Golden Keys. Three levels: the second looks like the Sea of Trees, Talus Cave or Death Mountain, and Vaati waits on the third.
items.reward: The Great Fairies now give Hero's Keys

sections.title: Hero's Keys
sections.note: After the golden door: 5,000 Rupees in a stage for its Hero's Key.

items.name: Sea of Trees: Hero's Key
items.howTo: Play the Sea of Trees again and finish with at least 5,000 Rupees between you. Keep everyone at full health: Rupee Fever doubles each Rupee's worth (multiplayer only in the Anniversary Edition).

items.name: Talus Cave: Hero's Key
items.howTo: Play Talus Cave again and finish with at least 5,000 Rupees between you.

items.name: Death Mountain: Hero's Key
items.howTo: Play Death Mountain again and finish with at least 5,000 Rupees between you.

items.name: Vaati's Palace: hero's door
items.howTo: The three Hero's Keys open a shutter between the silver and golden doors. Twelve levels mixing all three stages, with Big Manhandla, Dera Zol or Gouen every three levels and Vaati on the twelfth.
items.reward: Golden sword icon on the file
items.notes: Anniversary Edition: the Great Fairies also change their look. Zelda Wiki's game article says nine floors, but its Vaati's Palace page, Zelda Dungeon and the game's text all say 12.
